title: Great game but one suggestion
body: This game is loads of fun and I really enjoy it, but I think if it were closer to NFL showdown from a couple years back, it would be better. In seasons mainly, you got paired in a league against real people and you had a GameTime and when it was that time, you were able to watch the game and see every play. The games would last 5-10 minutes and it was very good to see who did what and how the games played out. But all in all, this is a good game.
